text.markup: **Once per Turn Attack Reaction** -- Banish a card from your hand face-down: Turn the banished card face-up. If it's an attack action card with cost 2 or less, put target attacking card with **stealth** from the active chain link on the bottom of its owner's deck, then put the banished card onto the active chain link as the attacking card.
